description: The three sources (web, social, audio), the Telegram notifier, and the 4 test fixtures, each with unit tests. Depends on FEAT-001 for the Item (hotline/sources/__init__.py) and Detection (hotline/detect.py) types and the uv environment. Independent of FEAT-003 (the CLI), which only wires these together.
steps: Create the 4 fixtures (self-contained HTML, no external assets): fixtures/contest_page.html (<title> + body with 'call now', 'first caller', 'win tickets'), fixtures/giveaway_page.html ('text in', 'whatsapp', 'giveaway', 'contest'), fixtures/closed_page.html (active-looking terms PLUS 'closed'/'no longer'/'ended' for the negation path), fixtures/transcript.txt (~10s callout: 'call now to win tickets, phone lines are open').

Create hotline/sources/web.py: `fetch_url(url, user_agent) -> str` using urllib.request with a polite configurable User-Agent (injectable). `robots_allowed(url, user_agent, checker=None) -> bool` using urllib.robotparser (injectable/fakeable). `parse_html(html, url, source='web') -> Item` via an html.parser.HTMLParser subclass that extracts the <title> and visible text (skip script/style). `poll_web(config, fetch=fetch_url, robots_checker=robots_allowed) -> Iterator[Item]` iterating config.contest_urls + optional config.feed_url, skipping robots-disallowed URLs, parsing each fetched page into an Item. Module/function docstrings.

Create hotline/sources/social.py: `poll_social(config, fetch=<default urllib fetcher>) -> Iterator[Item]`. If config.x_bearer set, call a `_fetch_x(fetch, bearer)` helper and yield Items (source='x'); if config.ig_token set, call `_fetch_ig(fetch, token)` and yield Items (source='instagram'); if neither token is set, yield nothing and never raise. fetch callable injectable so tests supply responses; no live calls in tests.

Create hotline/sources/audio.py: `iter_windows(lines_or_stream, window_seconds=10) -> Iterator[str]` pure windowing (testable over a transcript). `transcribe_stream(config, transcriber=None, source='audio') -> Iterator[Item]`: if not config.audio_enabled -> log once and yield nothing; else if transcriber is None, lazily `from faster_whisper import WhisperModel` inside the function and build a real transcriber, catching ImportError to log once and yield nothing (graceful degrade); for each 10s window produce transcript text and yield an Item. Structure so tests pass a fake transcriber over fixtures/transcript.txt and can simulate ImportError.

Create hotline/notify.py: `format_alert(detection, item) -> str` (readable: title, url, matched terms, score). `send_telegram(text, token, chat_id, post=<default urllib POST>) -> dict` building the Bot API URL (https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage) and payload (chat_id, text) with urllib; post injectable. `notify(detection, item, config, dry_run=False, post=...) -> str`: when dry_run, format+print+return the message WITHOUT calling post; else call post with the correct URL/payload and return the response. Depends on detect.Detection and sources.Item.

Extend tests/conftest.py with fake fetcher/robots/sender/transcriber factories. Create tests/test_web.py, tests/test_social.py, tests/test_audio.py, tests/test_notify.py covering the plan.md 'Test cases' (parse each fixture into Items; injected robots disallow skips a URL; social no-op without tokens and yields with injected fetch+token; audio windowing + fake transcriber + disabled no-op + simulated ImportError; notify dry-run does not call sender, real path calls injected sender with correct URL/payload). No network.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest tests/test_web.py tests/test_social.py tests/test_audio.py tests/test_notify.py` passes all tests.
`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` are clean.
parse_html on contest_page.html yields an Item whose text drives detect() above threshold; closed_page.html yields an Item that detect() suppresses (None).
poll_web skips a URL when the injected robots checker disallows it.
poll_social yields nothing and raises nothing when no tokens are configured.
transcribe_stream yields nothing (no raise) when audio_enabled is False and when faster_whisper import is simulated to fail; yields Items from fixtures/transcript.txt with a fake transcriber.
notify(..., dry_run=True) returns a formatted string and the injected post is never called; dry_run=False calls post once with a URL containing the token and a payload containing chat_id and text.
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_web.py tests/test_social.py tests/test_audio.py tests/test_notify.py
findings:
Sources + notifier + 4 fixtures landed; 21 feature tests pass (40 total suite), ruff check/format clean. No pyproject/uv.lock changes (stdlib-only; faster-whisper stays optional). No network in tests.

APIs for FEAT-003 (cli) to import:
- hotline.sources.web.fetch_url(url:str, user_agent:str, *, timeout:float=10.0)->str (urllib, polite UA). robots_allowed(url:str, user_agent:str, checker:object|None=None)->bool (urllib.robotparser; checker needs .can_fetch(ua,url); OSError reading robots => allow). parse_html(html:str, url:str, source:str='web')->Item (html.parser subclass; skips script/style/head/title for body text; title from <title>, falls back to url). poll_web(config, fetch=fetch_url, robots_checker=robots_allowed)->Iterator[Item]; iterates config.contest_urls then optional config.feed_url, skips robots-disallowed (never fetches them). INJECTION SIGNATURES: fetch=(url, user_agent)->html; robots_checker=(url, user_agent)->bool.
- hotline.sources.social.poll_social(config, fetch=_default_fetch)->Iterator[Item]. No-op (yields nothing, never fetches, never raises) when neither x_bearer nor ig_token set. x_bearer => _fetch_x => Items source='x'; ig_token => _fetch_ig => Items source='instagram'. INJECTION SIGNATURE: fetch=(url, headers:dict[str,str])->body_text (JSON). Constants X_SEARCH_URL, IG_MEDIA_URL. Parses {"data":[...]} shape (X: id/text/created_at; IG: id/caption/permalink/timestamp).
- hotline.sources.audio.iter_windows(lines_or_stream:Iterable[str], window_seconds:int=10)->Iterator[str] (pure; 1 line ~= 1s, groups window_seconds non-empty lines, skips blanks, flushes remainder; raises ValueError if window_seconds<1). transcribe_stream(config, transcriber:Callable[[str],str]|None=None, source:str='audio', *, windows:Iterable[str]|None=None)->Iterator[Item]. Gating: audio_enabled False => log + yield nothing; transcriber None => lazy `from faster_whisper import WhisperModel` built inside _build_whisper_transcriber (ImportError => log once + yield nothing). Items: title='Audio window {i}', url='{audio_stream_url or "audio-stream"}#t={i*10}', source='audio'; empty transcripts skipped. NOTE: production stream->windows wiring is a cli concern; transcribe_stream currently consumes the injected `windows` kwarg (empty default) so the module is fully unit-testable offline. DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS=10.
- hotline.notify.format_alert(detection, item)->str (title/url/source/score 2dp/matched terms). send_telegram(text, token, chat_id, post=_default_post)->dict builds https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage with payload {chat_id, text}. notify(detection, item, config, dry_run=False, post=_default_post)->str: dry_run prints+returns message WITHOUT post; else requires config.telegram_token and config.chat_id (ValueError if missing) and calls post once. INJECTION SIGNATURE: post=(url, payload:dict[str,str])->dict. Constant TELEGRAM_API_BASE.

conftest.py added factory fixtures: make_fetcher({url:body})->fetch(url,ua) with .calls; make_robots(disallowed:set|None)->checker(url,ua); make_social_fetcher({url_substr:body})->fetch(url,headers) with .calls; make_sender()->post(url,payload) with .calls returning {ok:True}; make_transcriber(transform=None)->transcriber(window) with .calls.

Fixtures: contest_page.html (call now/first caller/phone lines/win tickets + a <script> whose text is excluded), giveaway_page.html (giveaway/text in/whatsapp/contest), closed_page.html (active terms + closed/no longer/ended => detect() None), transcript.txt (3 lines; first = 'call now to win tickets, phone lines are open').

Deviations/notes:
- ImportError simulation in test_audio uses monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules,'faster_whisper',None) so the lazy import raises without installing the extra.
- web fetch_url/social _default_fetch/notify _default_post carry `# noqa: S310` though S-rules are not enabled; harmless and documents the trusted-URL intent.
